name: Pemayangtse Monastery
description: One of the oldest and most significant monasteries in Sikkim, known for its exquisite architecture and serene atmosphere.

name: Rabdentse Ruins
description: Ancient ruins of the former capital of Sikkim, offering panoramic views and a glimpse into the region's royal past.

name: Khecheopalri Lake
description: A sacred lake revered by Buddhists and Hindus, surrounded by lush forest and believed to fulfill wishes.

name: Singshore Bridge
description: One of the highest suspension bridges in Asia, offering breathtaking views of the surrounding valleys and waterfalls.

name: Rimbi Waterfalls
description: A picturesque waterfall nestled amidst dense forest, perfect for nature lovers and photographers.

name: Kanchenjunga Falls
description: A stunning waterfall named after the majestic Kanchenjunga mountain, ideal for a quick scenic stop.

name: Pelling Sky Walk
description: A thrilling skywalk offering panoramic views of the Kanchenjunga range and the surrounding valleys.

name: Chenrezig Statue
description: A giant statue of the Buddhist deity Chenrezig, symbolizing compassion and peace, set against a stunning backdrop.

name: Sangachoeling Monastery
description: A peaceful monastery perched on a hilltop, offering spiritual solace and spectacular views of the Himalayas.

name: Pelling Market
description: A bustling local market where visitors can experience authentic Sikkimese culture, cuisine, and handicrafts.

name: Tashiding Monastery
description: An ancient monastery known for its religious significance and intricate murals, nestled in a serene forest setting.

name: Khangchendzonga National Park
description: A UNESCO World Heritage site featuring diverse flora and fauna, alpine meadows, and stunning mountain vistas.

name: Hidden Valley
description: A lesser-known tranquil valley surrounded by dense forests and traditional villages, perfect for peaceful hikes.

name: Pelling Sky Resort
description: A resort offering adventure activities like zip-lining and rock climbing with spectacular mountain views.

name: Sikkim Himalayan Zoological Park
description: A zoo specializing in Himalayan fauna including red pandas, snow leopards, and Himalayan black bears.

name: Ralong Monastery
description: A vibrant monastery known for its colorful festivals and traditional Buddhist rituals.

name: Pelling Viewpoint
description: A popular spot to catch breathtaking sunrise and sunset views over the Kanchenjunga mountain range.

name: Local Handicraft Center
description: A center showcasing traditional Sikkimese crafts including handwoven textiles, wood carvings, and jewelry.

name: Kanchenjunga National Park Trek Start Point
description: Starting point for treks into the Kanchenjunga National Park, offering thrilling trails and pristine nature.

name: Sikkim Tea Garden
description: A scenic tea garden where visitors can learn about tea processing and enjoy fresh local brews.
